title: AWS Migration Services
description: Learn about AWS Migration Hub, Application Migration Service, and Database Migration Service for moving workloads to AWS.

data.text: AWS provides several services to help you move applications and databases to the cloud. The main tools are **AWS Migration Hub** for tracking, **Application Migration Service (MGN)** for servers, and **Database Migration Service (DMS)** for databases.
Migration Hub gives you a single place to track migrations across multiple AWS tools. You can see the progress of server, database, and data migrations in one dashboard.

data.title: How MGN Works
items: Install the MGN agent on your source servers
MGN continuously replicates your servers to AWS
When you are ready, you launch AWS instances with minimal downtime
MGN handles the cutover and lets you test before going live

data.text: DMS migrates relational databases, data warehouses, and NoSQL databases. It supports homogenous migrations (e.g., Oracle to Oracle) and heterogeneous migrations (e.g., Oracle to PostgreSQL).

terms.definition: Central tracking service for migration projects across AWS tools.
Application Migration Service — migrates servers with minimal downtime.
Database Migration Service — migrates databases with ongoing replication.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Migration Hub tracks all your migrations in one place
MGN replicates servers and enables low-downtime cutover
DMS migrates databases and supports ongoing change data capture
